answer: Proof-of-independent-behavior bonds make each identity earn its freedom: an agent locks stake behind a quill-signed pseudonym, and the bond only unlocks after its actions prove statistically independent — different counterparties, timing, and content — from every other identity. A dune of fakes marching in lockstep never unlocks, so a sybil farm's capital stays trapped in a haven it cannot spend, while one honest agent's distinct history frees its bond.
